name: com.eventescapes/event-escapes
title: Event Escapes
description: Event travel for AI agents: sports and concert events, hotels near venues, packages, payment links.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search upcoming sporting and music events bookable on Event Escapes. Covers F1, MotoGP, all major soccer leagues, NFL, NHL, MLB, NBA, tennis Grand Slams, rugby, cricket, golf, volleyball, boxing, MMA, horse racing, athletics, and major concerts. Filter by sport, city, country, or date range. Returns event inventory (tickets only); curated trip packages bundling tickets, hotel and experiences are returned by search_packages. Prices are estimates; the final price is set at checkout.

tools.name: search_packages
tools.description: Search hand-curated trip packages bundling event tickets + hotel + experiences. Packages live on dedicated /packages/ pages and include preview hotel, ticket category, and (sometimes) experience list. Filter by category (concerts, f1, world_cup, tennis, nfl, etc.), city, country, date range, or package type (single_event for one-day events; multi_event_city for multi-day city trips with multiple events). Returns complete trip recommendations; ticket-only inventory is returned by search_events. Prices include all package components.

category.description: Package category. Common values: concerts (1000+ packages), f1 (Formula 1 race weekends), world_cup (FIFA World Cup 2026), tennis (Grand Slams), nfl, mlb, nba, nhl, epl/la_liga/serie_a/bundesliga (soccer leagues), city_multi (multi-event city trips), festivals.

country.description: Filter by destination country name (e.g. 'England', 'USA', 'Spain'). Note: packages use country name, not ISO code.

package_type.description: single_event (one event) or multi_event_city (multiple events in one city trip).

tools.name: get_event_details
tools.description: Get full details for one event: title, venue, date and time, price range, description, and image gallery. Provide event_id (UUID) or slug from search_events results.

tools.name: search_hotels_near_event
tools.description: Find hotels within walking or short-transit distance of an event venue. If no check_in/check_out provided, defaults to one night before through one night after the event (2-night stay). Returns nightly price, total cost, distance, transport mode (walk vs rideshare), and travel time to venue.

tools.name: search_experiences
tools.description: Find activities, tours, attractions, food experiences, and nightlife in a city. If no date range provided, defaults to next 7 days. Returns activity name, price, duration, image, and whether free cancellation is offered.

tools.name: build_event_link
tools.description: Generate a deep link to the Event Escapes event detail page. The user lands on a page where they can review ticket categories, see hotels near the venue (auto-loaded), and complete booking themselves. Optionally pass hotel_id to pin a recommended hotel at the top of the hotels-near-venue list. This does not make a reservation; it is a navigation link only. Package pages are linked by build_package_link.

hotel_id.description: Optional hotel ID from search_hotels_near_event. If provided, this hotel will be pinned to the top of the hotels-near-venue list on the event page.

guests.description: Number of travellers as stated by the user. Optional, with no default: omit it when the number of travellers is unknown.

check_in.description: Optional check-in date (YYYY-MM-DD) to pre-fill on the page.

check_out.description: Optional check-out date (YYYY-MM-DD) to pre-fill on the page.

tools.name: build_package_link
tools.description: Generate a deep link to a curated Event Escapes PACKAGE detail page (/packages/{slug}). Packages are hand-curated bundles of event tickets + hotel + experiences. Takes a package_id or slug returned by search_packages. This does not make a reservation: the user reviews tier, duration and guest selectors and books on the package page.

guests.description: Number of travellers as stated by the user. Optional, with no default.

tools.name: create_payment_link
tools.description: Creates a booking cart and returns a secure Event Escapes payment URL for the customer. Locks live prices for up to 4 items: a hotel room from search_hotels_near_event, event tickets from search_events, or an experience from search_experiences (returned as a link to its own page, booked and paid there). Requires the customer's email, first and last name, customer_consent (the customer's own words asking to book these items) and agent_terms_accepted: true (the AI Agent Terms, https://eventescapes.com/terms/ai-agents). Large orders also need total_confirmation. This tool charges nothing: the customer pays on the payment page, and the card is only charged for the bookings that are confirmed (the few cases our team settles are set out in the AI Agent Terms). Returns status payment_link_ready with payment_url; site_links when only experiences were asked for; or action_required listing what is still needed (a ticket category, approval of a price change, or attendee details), in which case calling again with the same items plus those fields continues the booking. experience_link_caveats marks any experience link whose date or party must be checked on its page. A payment URL expires after about 30 minutes and replaces the customer's previous unpaid one. Event Escapes is the merchant of record, and every payment link is recorded with the agent, the consent, the items and the total.

customer_email.description: Customer's email address, exactly as the customer confirmed it. The receipt and booking confirmations are sent here.

customer_phone.description: Customer's mobile in E.164 (+61..., +1...), if known.

residency_country.description: Customer's country of residence, if stated (hotel prices vary by residency).

customer_consent.description: Required. The customer's own words asking to book these items (e.g. 'yes book the Marriott and 2 tickets').

items.description: What to book, in order. Each item is one hotel room, one ticket line, or one experience.

breakfast.description: HOTEL: true for a rate with breakfast included.

free_cancellation.description: HOTEL: true if the customer wants a refundable rate.

event_slug.description: EVENT: event slug, alternative to event_id.

ticket_id.description: EVENT: ticket category id. When omitted, the result lists the available categories.

quantity.description: EVENT: number of tickets the customer wants.

activity_id.description: EXPERIENCE: alias of activity_code (search_experiences returns it as activity_id).

child_ages.description: EXPERIENCE: age of each child, comma-separated.

modality_code.description: EXPERIENCE: option code, when a previous result listed options.

session_code.description: EXPERIENCE: time slot code, when a previous result listed options.

attendee_names.description: EVENT tickets for more than one attendee: comma-separated full names, when a previous result asked for them.

attendee_details.description: Attendee details, when a previous result asked for them: one entry per attendee separated by ';', e.g. 'name=John Smith, dob=1985-03-04, passport=N1234567, nationality=Australia', with only the fields that result named.

details_confirm_quote.description: Required when attendee_details includes a passport or date of birth: the customer's confirmation that the details are correct, given after being told they cannot be changed later.

accept_new_price.description: true to accept a price change reported by a previous result, once the customer has agreed to the new total.

promo_code.description: Promo code supplied by the customer, exactly as given.

agent_terms_accepted.description: Required, must be true: the calling agent accepts the Event Escapes AI Agent Terms (https://eventescapes.com/terms/ai-agents) and confirms it acts on this customer's instruction.

agent_name.description: Name of the AI assistant making the booking, e.g. 'Meta Muse' or 'Claude'. Recorded with the booking.

total_confirmation.description: Only when a previous result asked for it (large orders): the customer's own words confirming the stated total.
